Game Overview

Airport Master Plane Tycoon is a management title where manage a bustling airport using quirky 3D stickman models in a dynamic simulation. Strategically unlock facilities, hire assistants to streamline operations, and ensure smooth passenger flow. Tackle level objectives to earn stars for essential upgrades, and transform your airport into a thriving aviation hub.

How to Play

Playing Airport Master Plane Tycoon comes down to a simple loop. Manage a bustling airport using quirky 3D stickman models in a dynamic simulation! Strategically unlock facilities, hire assistants to streamline operations, and ensure smooth passenger flow. Tackle level objectives to earn stars for essential upgrades, and transform your airport into a thriving aviation hub.
